author: Codex; AI-authored proposals, not an independent annotator
authorization: 2026-09-21: researcher requested labels for initial model comparison while keeping them pending review (D-022). Individual labels have not been approved.

sources.use: Background on Ising formulations; case-specific formulas below are proposals checked against local programs, not quotations or whole-program guarantees.
Finite predicate search; ordered selection and absence certification remain separate obligations.

shared_rationale.practical_suitability: No adequate workload, loading/oracle cost, hardware or end-to-end benefit evidence. Missing evidence is not a NO label.
shared_rationale.benchmark_supported: This input release has no reviewed admissible migration contracts or complete quantum migration acceptance harness. This describes migration support, not whether analysis responses can now be scored.
shared_rationale.expected_decision: Provisional conservative adoption judgment under the supplied assumptions: retain the current program pending evidence. This constant label is not useful alone for ranking models.
shared_rationale.controls: lit-008/009/010 have no established supported mapping in this reference proposal. Structural null is unresolved, not a gold UNCERTAIN answer or proof that all reductions are impossible. Do not force NO merely to create class balance. Their software intent and obligations remain reviewable.
shared_rationale.families: Primary-family agreement is descriptive. A different supported family is not automatically wrong; inspect its concrete mapping. Family membership alone is not plan correctness. No text/keyword similarity grading.
shared_rationale.where: Regions are provisional anchor nominations, not an exhaustive set of admissible boundaries. Exact match and overlap are diagnostics only. Rejected candidates can be legitimate under D-016. Control regions are not positive-eligibility labels.

cases.intent: Exact weighted maximum cut; contextual proposal minimizes same-window conflict weight.
cases.mapping: x_i in {0,1} denotes membership in the first window. Maximize sum_{i<j} w_ij(x_i+x_j-2*x_i*x_j); minimize its negative as a QUBO. Context uses aggregated nonnegative weights. With s_i=1-2*x_i, the separated weight is sum w_ij(1-s_i*s_j)/2. This establishes the objective correspondence, not exact solver/tie preservation.

core_checks.criterion: Binary partition, correct weighted cut objective/sign, no added capacity or movement objective.
Identify exact global optimum and smallest first-window numeric mask; sampling a good cut does not establish either.
Decode both ascending index lists covering every item once; handle empty input and arbitrary-precision weights without silently rounding.

context_checks.criterion: Preserve repeated/reversed weight summation, input validation and nonmutation.
Preserve named ordering, current/proposed conflict reports and changes; movement is reporting, not an optimization objective.

cases.intent: Exact minimum-cardinality vertex cover with lexicographic selected-index tie breaking.
cases.mapping: x_i=1 selects station i. Minimize sum_i x_i + P*sum_{(u,v) in E}(1-x_u)(1-x_v), P>n. A feasible cover costs at most n, whereas any infeasible assignment costs at least P. Therefore minimizers are minimum covers. Tie selection is a separate obligation; it is not smallest numeric bitmask.

core_checks.criterion: Select vertices, cover each edge at one or both endpoints, minimize number selected; provide valid constraint or penalty reasoning.
Identify exact optimality and lexicographically smallest sorted selected-index tuple; distinguish it from numeric-mask order.
Return the selected-index set and preserve empty-edge behavior; feasible alone is not optimal.

context_checks.criterion: Retain full validation and deduplication of reversed/duplicate connections; current may be infeasible.
Assign covered connections once to earliest selected endpoint; retain ordered/empty checklists and reassignment reporting.

cases.intent: Finite graph-coloring completion, distinct from ordered greedy preview.
cases.mapping: Search colors c in {0,...,k-1}^n; mark iff every edge has c_u!=c_v. Binary registers must reject codes >=k. The alternative one-hot QUBO minimizes sum_i(sum_a x_ia-1)^2 + sum_edges sum_a x_ua*x_va; zero energy iff a valid coloring exists. Both establish a structural mapping. Lexicographic selection, infeasibility and the observable greedy operation remain obligations.

core_checks.criterion: Encode full color assignments, reject invalid color codes and enforce every adjacency inequality (or equivalent one-hot QUBO).
Distinguish greedy preview blockage from infeasibility; preserve both exposed operations.
Identify lexicographic first complete assignment and no-solution guarantee; failed sampling is not an infeasibility certificate; handle n=0/k=0.

context_checks.criterion: Preserve inspect mode, retain feasible current exactly, use completion only after prescribed greedy preview blocks.
Build conflicts from shared participants; do not fix partial current/failed preview choices; preserve status, preview and ordered moves.

cases.intent: Maximum-cardinality clique, separate from ascending-order greedy preview.
cases.mapping: x_i selects eligible vertex i. Minimize -sum_i x_i + P*sum_{i<j, incompatible} x_i*x_j with P>n. Empty selection has energy 0; any incompatible selection has energy >0, so minima are maximum cliques. Alternatively search subset masks with compatibility and cardinality threshold, including optimum certification. Latest checks and active filtering define the contextual graph.

core_checks.criterion: Use pairwise compatibility and maximum cardinality, not maximality or greedy success; valid QUBO penalty or search threshold.
Retain exact greatest size and smallest numeric-mask tie, sorted return list and empty/singleton behavior.
Preserve the separate greedy operation and the view's representation (set in the core, ordered reports in context); a larger answer does not preserve this operation.

context_checks.criterion: Latest undirected check wins; unknown is not passed; filter active requested versions in global order; requests independent.
Preserve preview even when suboptimal, inspect/select branching, current descriptions and ordered changes; do not minimize moves.

cases.intent: Find the first Boolean feature assignment satisfying all three-literal clauses and locks.
cases.mapping: Search x in {0,1}^n with f(x)=AND_locked[x_i=l_i] AND_clauses OR_(i,v in clause)[x_i=v]. A reversible implementation computes this predicate, marks phase and uncomputes workspace. Repeated/contradictory literals remain literal predicates; empty clause list is true. Search correspondence does not establish lexicographic-first or no-solution semantics. An optimization alternative needs an explicit penalty/quadratization mapping.

core_checks.criterion: Conjoin all clauses and all locked values; preserve polarity and repeated/contradictory literals.
Identify False-before-True vector order (not little-endian numeric mask), exact absence/None behavior, and empty-domain edge cases.
Explain reversible predicate access and workspace cleanup as obligations; merely naming Grover is insufficient.

context_checks.criterion: Validate all fields; inspect gives no proposal; retain conforming current even when not first; only otherwise search.
Failures describe current; locks/failures/changes follow declared feature/rule order, not dictionary insertion order.

cases.intent: Exact 0/1 knapsack for independent transfer windows; current implementation uses dynamic programming.
cases.mapping: Select x_i in {0,1}, maximize sum v_i*x_i subject to sum w_i*x_i<=C. Introduce binary slack s in [0,C] and minimize -sum v_i*x_i + P*(sum w_i*x_i+s-C)^2, P>sum v_i. Encode every integer slack 0..C; invalid extra codes cannot achieve zero penalty. Integer weights make nonzero residual squared >=1, and the feasible empty selection has energy 0. Coefficient precision, register sizes, exact optimum and ties remain obligations.

core_checks.criterion: Model each indivisible item once with capacity constraint and value objective; a valid penalty/slack or search formulation.
Identify exact value maximum and smallest numeric-mask tie; decode the mask and account for zero values/capacity.
Recognize the existing DP and its dependence on capacity; do not claim speedup by comparing only against exhaustive enumeration.

context_checks.criterion: Filter active items in catalogue order and solve each window independently; current may include inactive items.
Preserve whole-batch validation, inspect mode and contiguous ordered transfer offsets derived from selected weights.

cases.intent: Exact signed pair preference maximization, including together and apart relationships.
cases.mapping: x_i is group membership. Maximize sum_(i,j,w) w*(2*x_i+2*x_j-4*x_i*x_j-1). With s_i=1-2*x_i, maximize -sum w*s_i*s_j, equivalently minimize sum w*s_i*s_j. Together gives w=-1 and apart gives w=+1. Negative pair weights must not be discarded; the constant term matters for reports even when omitted from minimization.

core_checks.criterion: Correct signs/constants for together/apart, equivalent QUBO/Ising or threshold predicate, and complete pair dependence.
Identify exact maximum and smallest numeric-mask tie; preserve empty/singleton behavior and allow empty groups.
Do not add balance/capacity constraints or infer exactness from finite-depth QAOA sampling.

context_checks.criterion: Inspect gives no proposal; propose uses the specified tie even when current is equally good.
Validate one preference per pair and preserve group order, violated pairs, gain and moved-member reports.

cases.intent: Deterministic eight-bit XOR and full ordered receipts, not a supplied search or optimization problem.
cases.mapping: The immediate mapping is reversible Boolean arithmetic, outside the two positive families. A generic SAT/circuit reduction is conceivable but no meaningful supported mapping is established here; structural eligibility remains unresolved rather than universally false.

core_checks.criterion: Recognize exact XOR and eight-bit most-significant-first string, not addition or a random sample.
Distinguish reversible arithmetic from a demonstrated Grover/QUBO mapping; any alternative needs explicit variables/predicate and conditions.

context_checks.criterion: Preserve every ordered receipt, popcount and prefix checksum; no sample/aggregate substitution.
Counts are deterministic multiplicities, not empirical shots; validate the whole input and preserve inspect behavior.

cases.intent: Dense pivoted linear-system solution and residual diagnostics over binary64 inputs.
cases.mapping: Linear-system quantum algorithms are outside current positive families. A discretized residual-minimization QUBO would need explicit variable encoding/domain and correspondence to the numerical core; those essential details are unresolved here. A real quadratic residual alone does not establish a binary QUBO. Do not infer NO solely from missing mapping evidence.

core_checks.criterion: Identify pivoted solve and explicit residual vector/scaled diagnostic, with float and nonmutation semantics.
Do not silently introduce a linear-system family or assume a residual QUBO without finite encoding and correspondence evidence.
Preserve zero-pivot and detected-overflow errors; a low residual alone does not discharge the software contract.

context_checks.criterion: Inspect does not solve and need not reject a singular matrix; caller residual_limit is not a benchmark quantum tolerance.
Return full named vector, deltas and diagnostics; finite solution/current can still overflow on subtraction.

cases.intent: Budgeted unpreconditioned conjugate-direction recurrence with observable iterate and residual trace.
cases.mapping: The specified computation is a finite numerical recurrence, not just its eventual linear-system solution or a discrete optimizer. No concrete supported predicate/QUBO correspondence for that core is established; a generic unrolling/bit encoding would require additional evidence. Alternative quantum linear algebra does not by itself settle this mapping or contract.

core_checks.criterion: Recognize the requested finite recurrence from current, budget and relative stopping rule; an exact solution is not an interchangeable result.
Preserve iterate, initial norm and recurrent residual trace; budget exhaustion is not convergence, zero initial residual takes zero steps.
Identify absent supported mapping and numerical breakdown obligations; no automatic positive from matrix-vector loops.

context_checks.criterion: Preserve sparse normalization, symmetry/positive strict diagonal dominance validation and inspect branch.
Return full named iterate and recomputed final residual separately from recurrent residual trace.
